headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, driving in two runs. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 6 RBIs, and a strong performance from Will Warren on the mound, who struck out 8 batters in 5.2 innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Colorado Rockies placed RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins transferred RHP Josh Ekness from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right calf strain. The Athletics transferred RHP Luis Severino from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Atlanta Braves acquired RHP Tyler Schoff from the Washington Nationals. The Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired C Joey Bart from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for RHP Hunter Stratton.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, driving in two runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 6 RBIs, and a strong performance from Will Warren on the mound, who struck out 8 batters in 5.2 innings.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Rangers 6-4**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Manny Machado leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs. Walker Buehler pitched 5.1 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, led by standout performances from impact hitters Blake Dunn and Noelvi Marte. Chase Burns also made a significant contribution on the mound for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Braves 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 9-4 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with multiple players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Brewers included William Contreras, Jake Bauers, Sal Frelick, David Hamilton, Mauricio Dubón, and Rowdy Tellez, while Robert Gasser and Bryce Elder stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Blas Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Acquire RHP Tyler Schoff in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff, acquired in a trade with the Washington Nationals.
